publish.title: Tally: notes with no account (a fictional sample)
publish.description: A sample app launch video. Tally is a made-up product.

scenes.headline: Notes, minus the sign-up
scenes.narration: A sample launch for a fictional app: Tally, notes with no account.

scenes.headline: Open. Type. Done.
scenes.narration: You open it, you type, and it is saved. There is nothing else in the way.

scenes.headline: No sign-up
scenes.narration: Most notes apps want an email first. Tally starts empty and stays on your device.

scenes.headline: What it does
scenes.narration: Plain text notes, quick search, and export to a file whenever you like.

scenes.headline: A fictional app
scenes.narration: Tally is made up, used here to show what a launch video can look like.
